description: Réservations parkings Saemes is a dataset listed in Saemes OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saemes. Ce jeu de donnée recense les urls des pages parking du site www.saemes.fr et www.saemes.fr/en qui renvoient vers une plateforme de réservation. Coverage: Paris region (Saemes car parks). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. The portal shows 41 records. The portal shows 2026-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-saemes-fr-portal.
